title: Various client improvements.
PokéBonk now has an app for Android and Mac.

notes.text: **Android app** and **Mac app**: download them for free from the **Apps** button in the menu.
The **PC app 1.4.0** **updates itself** and shows on **Discord** what you're playing, with which Pokémon and in which zone (you can turn it off in Settings → Display).
A **new, clearer** download page, with screenshots of the game itself.

title: Lavender Tower, cleaner until the event ends.

notes.text: The **Lavender Tower** anti-cheat now checks the **damage on the Beyond floors**: impossible climbs no longer stay at the top of the **event leaderboard**.

title: The server is tidying up again.

notes.text: The server **cleans out** old data nobody uses **on its own** again, so it stays **smooth** at peak hours. Your records, history and progress don't change.

title: Your Ultimate charges like it used to.

notes.text: Undid a change from v0.8.85: the kills your **Ultimate makes as it ends** **charge the next one** again, as always. With the same build, you hold out like before when the horde surrounds you.

title: New version 1.3.0 of the PC app.

notes.text: **Desktop app 1.3.0**: the Windows installer lets you **choose the folder** and creates the **shortcut**. Download it from the **App** pill in the menu.
**Linux and Steam Deck**: the app now starts on systems that closed it on launch, and right-click lets you **copy and paste**.

title: Co-op connects better and your runs are no longer lost.

notes.text: «Connecting…» is **much faster**: a direct connection is tried first and the relay is kept for those who need it. If you reload the page in a room, **you return to the same room**.
**Find a match** no longer puts you in rooms whose leader is away. The leader has **30 s** to start and the team can **vote to kick them**.
Players in **mainland China** are matched with each other, and co-op **counts for your clan's missions**.
**Save and quit** keeps a copy on your account: continue your run on **any device**. If it can't save right then, it saves as soon as it can.
If the game closes suddenly, when you come back you can **continue your run** from the last autosave. Your **build plans** and **Archive presets** are also saved to your account.
**Fewer crashes** on iPhone, iPad and PC: the game uses much less memory.
Keys, controller and joystick that got **stuck**, the Tower stairs, zoom on mobile, and **older Safari**, which can now play.
Repeated shinies, Aspects that didn't count a fusion's damage, and **two invulnerability exploits** closed.
**Desktop app**: V-Sync is now always on, so the FPS shown are real and the game runs smoothly.

title: Your runs no longer stay unranked.

notes.text: Runs the anti-cheat flagged as unusual now **count on the leaderboard right away**: we review them afterwards and only remove the ones that really are cheating.
The best scores of each map and of the Global board **no longer wait for review**: they go onto the leaderboard as soon as you finish.

title: In the desktop app, Esc no longer takes you out of fullscreen.

notes.text: **Desktop app**: pressing **Esc** no longer takes you out of **fullscreen**; now it only pauses and closes menus. To leave fullscreen, use **F11** or the fullscreen button.
To get it, download **version 1.2.0** of the app from the **App** pill in the menu: the app will let you know when you open it.

title: Kicking someone from your clan no longer sends you back to the top of the list.

notes.text: When you **kick** someone from the clan, change their rank or mute them, the member list **stays where it was** instead of jumping back to the top.

The best marks on each map and on the Global board are now **reviewed before they show up on the leaderboard**: if yours gets there, you'll see “Run under review” and we'll let you know in your mailbox.

title: You can now play PokéBonk with its official PC app.

notes.text: Free **desktop app** for **Windows** and **Linux** (also **Steam Deck**): download it from the **App** pill in the menu. macOS coming soon.
In the app: its own loading screen and **Settings → Display** with window, resolution, monitor, V-Sync and graphics backend.

«Enemies drawn» now works at the end of long runs: **Nearby** and **Very close** draw only the 300 or 120 nearest, and the new **Shadows only** draws none (they are still there; you only see their shadow). Many more FPS with huge hordes.
A run kept with **Save and quit** goes on with the **Archive** it had: changing it before resuming no longer changes that run.

title: Public rooms no longer sit waiting for a leader who never starts.

notes.text: The **leader** of a public room has **60 seconds** to press “Start!” once the team is in; otherwise they leave the room and **the next player leads**.
Everyone in the room can see how long the leader has left, and the leader gets a warning **20 seconds** before.
While you are still connecting to each other the clock stops: nobody is removed for a slow connection.
**Find a match** no longer puts you in rooms whose leader has run out of time.

title: Co-op without unfair rejections and a sharper anti-cheat.

notes.text: **Co-op** runs with the window covered or on another screen are no longer rejected for «the play time doesn't match»: the clock no longer runs fast.
**Team Survival** no longer rejects runs for «Inconsistent bosses».
A **saved run** you finish right after coming back is no longer rejected.
The **Rainbow Wing** now shows the big banner when it revives you, like the Max Revive.
The **anti-cheat** catches more cheats and more bots, without touching anyone who plays fair.

**Anti-cheat review**: **146 accounts banned for good** (95 for cheating, 46 bots and 5 for auto-play) and removed from the leaderboards. **195 reports** reviewed: 8 offensive names changed, 10 messages deleted and 3 players muted for racism.
**5 unfair bans lifted** and **18 runs restored** that had been rejected by the co-op and saved-run bugs. Sorry to everyone affected!

title: Fixes: jumping and keys, Continue, co-op rooms, boss warnings and more.

notes.text: **Jumping** that only worked once per map and **keys that got stuck** now respond properly.
**Continue** on a saved run works even if you reload the page, and you no longer come back fainted.
Abandoned **public rooms** no longer stay open, so «Find a match» takes you to rooms with people.
Bosses' **charge** line now has **red edges** and is visible on any ground, the Desert included.
If your attacks are hidden (the **H** key or Settings), you'll now always see it on screen.

On the **Coast**, Poké Balls no longer land where the tide covers them. Fixed item descriptions on **mobile**, frames in the Look challenges, type names in Chinese and Korean, and the name of Ditto's attack.

title: Team pause and a bubble reserve in co-op, the H key explained and lots of fixes.

notes.text: **Can't see your attacks or damage numbers?** It's the **H** key: it hides or shows them all at once. Now it only lasts **the run where you press it**, and if it got stuck on, you can see everything again.

The **bubble** while picking upgrades is now a **reserve**: you start with **45 seconds**, each level adds 15 (up to 90) and it slowly refills. Rerolling, banishing or skipping no longer burn it all at once.

**Team pause**: press **P** (or «Ask the team to pause» in the menu) and once everyone accepts, the run stops. The team has **5 minutes** of pause per run, and it goes on when everyone votes to resume.
A **fainted** teammate no longer deals damage, dropped connections **reconnect on their own**, and «Find a match» no longer puts you back in the room you just left.

**Shiny legendaries**: Articuno, Zapdos, Moltres, Mewtwo and Mew have their own per-account chance, which **rises with every attempt** until it's guaranteed. If you already have them, they come back when their shiny is due.
When you weaken a legendary, we tell you it **joins your League**. If a finished run doesn't get through (for example during maintenance), the game **keeps it and resends it** on its own.
**Save and quit** remembers the explored map and, if you saved on **another device**, tells you so and lets you discard it. New **«Stuck»** button in the pause menu.

Fixed the **Mewtwo** challenge when you rush the guardian, the slot machine **777**, the **Ultimate** when holding R or levelling up, aiming that switched on its own, the **mobile menu** covering the news, and the rivals notice in **dark theme**.

title: Various client improvements.
The logo says where the official game is: PokéBonk.com.

notes.text: The logo now shows **PokéBonk.com**: it's the game's only official website. Some sites copy PokéBonk or embed it in their pages with ads; always play on **pokebonk.com** so your account and progress stay safe.

title: Public rooms no longer get stuck with an absent leader.

notes.text: If the **leader** of a public room doesn't touch anything for **90 seconds**, they leave the room and **the next player leads**, so you can start without waiting for them.
Before leaving, the leader sees **“Still there?”** with a countdown: just move the mouse or press a key.
If you're waiting alone in the search and don't touch anything for **3 minutes**, the search is cancelled.

title: Find a match in co-op, a signal wheel to talk without voice, and a fairer bubble while choosing.

notes.text: **Find a match**: on the co-op screen pick a mode, team (duo, trio or squad), map and difficulty, or «Any», and we'll team you up with other trainers looking for the same, from your region first.
**Public rooms** have a **leader** (the crown) who picks the map and starts whenever you're ready. When the match ends you go back to the room to chat and play another.
In your friends' room, turn on **Find teammates** so other trainers can fill the free seats.

**Signal wheel**: hold **G** (L3 on a gamepad) and pick Here!, To the boss!, Look at this!, To the portal!, Thanks!, Wait!, Careful! or Help!. Each one places itself where it belongs. A tap of G marks the spot you're looking at.
The **bubble** while choosing upgrades gives **5 seconds per level** (up to 10) and no longer refills by itself: when it runs out, you can be hit while you choose.
Co-op is now for trainers **with an account**: if you play as a guest, it shows you how to create one in a moment, without losing your progress.

title: Save & quit in long runs, Bill's Machine in Team Survival and a new Clans screen.

notes.text: Revamped **Clans** screen for players without a clan: a finder with clans as cards and quick filters, a ranking with a podium and «Found your clan» on the side.
In **Team Survival**, **Bill's Machine** works again 11 minutes after you use it.
With a controller, the **Big map** is an action you can bind in Settings → Keys: it is on R3, or put it on Select if you prefer.
In the **Pokédex** you can view each Pokémon as normal, shiny or classic shiny, depending on which you have.
**Treasure** frames no longer make pages with many of them stutter, and the **glossary** better explains Status damage, item attacks and when a mega crit happens.
**Save & quit** now works in long runs: it got stuck on «Wait a moment».
The **Dawn Stone** is no longer wasted if you clear zone 1 before its shiny shows up: it appears in the next zone.
In **Lavender Tower**, the camera no longer turns straight down when you stand against a wall.

**Look** challenges now name the right move in Russian, French, Korean, Japanese and Chinese; in Safari the sound stops when you switch tabs, and in the co-op room the Bag no longer covers the invitations.
The **type filter** when choosing a Pokémon now counts its evolutions: Dratini shows under Flying thanks to Dragonite, and the Nidoran under Ground.
In **co-op**, if the server is very busy, your run waits longer before asking it again, so it recovers sooner for everyone.
The **Ultimate** is ready again as soon as the gauge is full, in auto mode too: the 10-second wait between Ultimates is gone.

title: Team Survival, and an Ultimate that tells you how long it needs.

notes.text: **Team Survival**: pick the Survival mode in the co-op room. A shared boss every 4 minutes, Cataclysm, Apocalypse and a horde that wipes out any team: how long can you hold out together?
Fallen teammates come back when the team beats the next boss, and there's a **team leaderboard** by time survived.
The **Ultimate** no longer looks stuck "one pixel short": after you fire one, the medallion counts down the seconds to the next, and R tells you too.
The game only saves your settings when they change: less load on the server at peak times.
The **Halloween event** screen no longer errors out when lots of people are playing.
**Co-op** and settings put much less load on the server: rooms and menus run smoother at peak times.
Fixed the **“No connection to the server”** drops when coming back from maintenance.
**The server no longer collapses** at peak times: when it's very busy it tells you right away instead of leaving you waiting, and your runs are still saved.

title: Save and quit: leave your run halfway and pick it up another day right where you left it.

notes.text: **Save and quit**: from the pause, save your run (classic, Daily Mutation or Survival) and continue it another day **exactly as it was**: the wild Pokémon, the Poké Balls, the clock and your build.
When you come back, the game asks whether to **continue** the saved run or **finish** it and keep what you earned. You can't save in the middle of a boss fight or an event.
The **League legendaries** (Mew, Articuno, Zapdos, Moltres and Mewtwo) join your League **as soon as you weaken them**. You only need the Poké Ball to keep their shiny.
**Gliding over water** no longer slows you down, neither on Storm Coast nor with Zapdos' tide.
The descriptions of several items and of **status damage** now say exactly what they do.
Runs **under 1 minute** no longer show up in your history or the rankings; their progress still counts.
Closed two **endless invulnerability** tricks: opening and closing the slot machine in co-op, and the chained automatic Ultimate.

title: Daily Mutation fixes and a sharper anti-cheat.

notes.text: **Metronome**: moves that turned into a beam no longer get stuck; they keep changing every 30 seconds in every zone.
The **Daily Mutation frames** you've already earned now show up in the **Frames** tab of the avatar picker.
On a run's build card, the **damage of each move** no longer stops at the same cap in long runs: you'll see how much each one really did.
Sharper **anti-cheat**: fewer false positives with Gengar and in co-op, and the bots flooding the Desert leaderboard no longer get through.

title: Daily Mutation: a different run every day, with its own leaderboard and prizes to keep.

notes.text: **New mode: the Daily Mutation.** Every day, a classic run with a **different twist**, the same for everyone: same map, same world and same mutation. Find it in the menu's first row, next to Survival.
Play with **any League Pokémon you like** and try as many times as you want: your **best run of the day** counts (how far you get, then your KOs). No Bag and no co-op.
**Metronome** (Nightmare): every 30 seconds one of your moves turns into a random one from the whole League, at the same level. Your first move and fusions never change.
**Dynamax Wilds** (Hard): wild Pokémon are twice as big with twice the HP; they hit 50% harder but move 15% slower. Bosses don't change.
**Candy Fever** (Hard): double experience and Pokédollars, but Pokémon get stronger 60% faster.
**Glass** (Normal): only a quarter of your HP, but all your damage is doubled.
The four take turns: each comes **once every 4 days**, never two days in a row, and moves to a new map each time. It changes at **00:00 UTC**, and the screen shows the ones coming next.
A **daily leaderboard** for each mutation, plus yesterday's and the day before's. **Stardust** once a day: 60 for zone 2, 60 for zone 3, 60 for the sanctuary and 120 for winning (300 in total).

**Prizes to keep** in every mutation: its **title** for reaching zone 3, its **avatar frame** for reaching the sanctuary and its **profile background** for winning it. With all four backgrounds, the title **King of Mutations**.
**Profile backgrounds**, a new cosmetic: the picture behind your name on your trainer card. Pick it in the **Backgrounds** tab, next to avatar, frame and title.
You can feel the mutation in the run: a banner at the start of each zone, its medallion next to the top plate and, in Metronome, a countdown and every move swap shown big.
**Slot machine**: hold **E** (or the gamepad button) to spin non-stop. Prizes pile up in a tray and you see them all when you let go or run out of Pokédollars.
**Leaderboard goals**: once you reach the prize top you no longer jump from #50 to #25: you chase **every rival, one by one** (#50, #49, #48…).
When you catch a **second shiny**, you now tap the one you **release**, just like replacing an Alpha.
The **Play** button no longer gets cut off in the menu.

title: Looks challenges in co-op, your Bag in the room and a clearer wallet.

notes.text: **Looks challenges now count in co-op**: «win» is the team's victory and each challenge looks at what you do. Only the «taking at most N hits» ones stay solo. Runs you finish from now on count.
You can now bring your **Bag** to co-op: pick your items in the room, under the difficulty. They're only used up if the run starts.
The **legendary's shiny roll** is the same for the whole team: if one of you gets it, you all do.
Falling while a teammate's connection hiccups **no longer ends the run**.
If your team beats the guardian and the portal didn't show up for you, **it now appears** after a few seconds.
The **«Ready»** window no longer stays on top of the run, and the room **connects better** when the server is busy or the network is tricky.

**New wallet** at the top centre: your **PokéDollars, bigger**, and on the same line what the **Poké Ball**, the **slot machine** and **refreshing Meowth** cost right now. Each price turns green when you can afford it.
Goodbye to the «Calm / Dangerous…» meter under the clock: **more room** on screen.
**Controller**: L3 releases the fallen Alpha, Select shows the map without pausing, and the stick no longer drifts on its own.
**Shinies**: Venusaur no longer looks normal, and **14 nearly grey Pokémon** (Geodude, Onix, Dewgong, Magnemite, Mewtwo…) get a shiny that really stands out.
**Chinese or Japanese keyboard**: if your input method blocks WASD, the game tells you how to switch it, and E and your attacks respond.
**Android**: the «back» gesture from the screen edge no longer pauses the run while you use the joystick, and the stick no longer gets stuck.
If the **picture goes black** with the interface still visible, the game tries to bring it back on its own.
**Sound effects** no longer vanish leaving only the music, and there are fewer volume spikes.
**Light Screen** looks like glass, not white squares.
The keyboard's **skip track** key no longer stops your Pokémon.

title: Fixes from your reports: shinies, challenges, older iPhones and attack effects.

notes.text: The sanctuary's **legendary shiny** is no longer lost when you already have many shinies in the same run.
The **Dawn Stone** is no longer spent without a shiny: if you clear the first zone very fast, it shows up in the next one.

The **no-evolving** challenges (Charmander, Dratini) count your form when you beat the final boss, even if its experience evolves you afterwards. **By a hair** checks your HP when you beat it, so the berry it drops no longer takes it away.
Many attacks of the newest League Pokémon came out with **another move's effect and sound** (Thunder Cage with a pink moon). They look right now.
The game opens again on **iPhone and iPad with iOS 15**, which were stuck on «Retry».
**Chansey** can learn Transformation and Mimic at the same time to make Ditto's fusion.
On the rooftop of the **Lavender Tower**, the way-down stairs ask you to confirm before ending the run.
The summary of a co-op run reminds you that **Looks challenges** only count in solo.
**View my team** (Tab on level-up) also shows what each attack's level-up upgrades add up to.
Fewer honest runs sent to review: **co-op**, gold and long runs get more leeway.

title: Clan prizes for everyone who contributes, password change in Settings and boss health as a percentage.

notes.text: **Clan season prizes**: you no longer need 2% of the clan's total. **500 points and a quarter of the average** of the members who scored is enough: if everyone contributes about the same, **everyone gets it**. In the Clan tab, "Your contribution" shows how many points you have and how many you need.
You can now **change your password** in Settings → Account. Changing it signs you out on your other devices.
Settings → Interface → **Boss health**: boss bars can show the **percentage** they have left instead of HP.
In the pause menu, Stats show how much a **mega crit** deals and make clear that crit damage **has no cap**.

In the Clan tab, **Clan slots** and **Season prizes** are no longer squashed; "From levels" says **hits** for melee attacks, and the **Change** button is better translated in English, Japanese and Korean.

title: Solo runs save again on every browser.

notes.text: **Solo runs** now save even if your browser doesn't keep data (some tablets and apps): before, the server couldn't save them and their rewards and catches were lost.
In the **Lab**, every item you haven't unlocked yet says **how many copies** you can take into a run.

title: Much better clan rewards, new avatar frames and fixes from your reports.

notes.text: **Much better clan rewards**: each mission star gives up to **2,000 Stardust** and a Bag item, and the third one a **Bonkoin**. Winning the rivalry gives **1,500 Stardust, 2 Bonkoins and a Master Ball**.
**Three clan avatar frames**, each with its title: **Clan Star**, **Unbeaten Rival** and **Legendary Clan**. See them in the Clan tab.
The **Aspect frames** you own can be worn as your avatar frame.
The **Shop** tells you how many items fit in your Bag and how many you can still buy.
Attack cards show the **minimum cooldown** (0.12 s) and tell you when an attack cannot get any faster.
The **Lickitung** challenge asks for **7,000 HP** healed in one run (it was 8,000).

A **room** no longer opens in the middle of a solo run, the same Pokémon can no longer be **caught** several times, the **next map** unlocks without remaking the room, and a teammate fainted in mid-air **falls to the ground** so you can revive them.

Fixed: the **Korean keyboard** (A/S/D), the **Release** button on mobile, the **Golden Magikarp** challenge, extra **Bonkoins** that dropped without being paid, and going back to Seen and Families in the Pokédex.

title: A bigger Archive as you unlock items, and level-up upgrades shown in the pause.

notes.text: **Archive**: every 2 items you unlock give you **1 more slot** (up to 59). The Lab upgrade tells you how many you have and where they come from.
In the pause, each move shows **what its level-up upgrades add up to** (damage, cooldown, projectiles…).
Co-op runs no longer start by **skipping zones** when you play again with the same team.
Fewer honest runs sent to review: co-op, very long Survival runs and back-to-back short runs.
Over **100 cheating accounts and bots** removed from the leaderboards.
The event image in the menu, news covers, the Treasures background and the Lab's 4th move icon show again.

title: Altars by zone in the pause menu, Rhydon's roars on screen and clearer item stats.

notes.text: **Altars in the pause menu**: what each altar gave you, zone by zone, plus the total.
**Rhydon's roars** show on screen while its guardian is still standing.
**Stats** show the extra damage from the Metronome and friends, and items that strike on their own get their own row.
If your connection to a teammate goes through our server, it uses less data.

title: See your teammates' attacks and less waiting at peak hours.

notes.text: **See your teammates' attacks** just as they cast them. In Options → Graphics you can simplify or hide them.
Co-op rooms ask the server far less often: the game runs smoother for everyone at peak hours.
News and game status load faster.
The server holds up better during long peak hours: it no longer builds up memory over time.

title: A lighter server for peak hours.

notes.text: **Faster server** at peak hours: co-op leaderboards and rooms ask for much less.
If a teammate leaves the run, your game stops searching for them nonstop after a minute.

title: We went through over 1,000 reports: the M map, a steadier co-op, fusions explained and dark mode in runs.

notes.text: **Fusions explained**: every fusion says how it works (its parts: meteor, barrage, zone…) and what Area, Duration and Projectiles do to each part.
**Search** on the Pokémon selection screen: type its name or number.
**After beating the guardian**, an arrow and the minimap lead you to its Great Ball and then to the portal.
**Shared map**: what a teammate discovers (Poké Balls, altars, Ditto…) also shows up on your map.
**Damage per player** in the final summary and the pause menu.
Go to the **Lab** from the room without leaving the group, and come back with “Back to the room”.
If you go down just before the team takes the portal, the run no longer ends and you aren't left behind: you revive with them.
With a bad connection the team no longer splits across different zones, and the horde no longer pushes you out of an altar while you pick an upgrade.
**Dark mode across the whole run**: portrait, timer, items, moves, notices and boss bars.
“Your Team” is now called **Favorites**: they're your favorite Pokémon and change nothing in the run.
Only clan members can see the clan's **Activity** now.
Auto Ultimate shows **AUTO** on its medallion when it's on.
Mobile: Bill's Machine always shows “Not now”, and you can cancel a banish.
Low rocks can be jumped over, and rocks and trees don't trap you as much.
When you come back signed out, the game offers to sign in to your account instead of creating an empty guest.
Clan names accept more letters, the game remembers your language and the menu leaderboard remembers what you were looking at.
**Closing the map with M no longer opens the pause menu**, and “Continue” gets you back in the game on the first click.
The camera turns again after closing the shop or a menu, and keys no longer get stuck (the Pokémon that walked on its own).
Lavender Tower: floors no longer get stuck unfinished and you don't get trapped inside the boss.
The boss's Great Ball no longer lands under the portal, and Whirlpool no longer stops casting with lots of Duration.
In Survival runs over 6 hours you no longer become immortal, and huge numbers are readable.
The Meowth challenge counts all your money, plus fixes to the Shiny star, the slot machine in dark mode and the minimap arrow.
